name: Linker Bell Academia ~Alchemist wa Koi Wazurau~
original_name: リンカーベル・アカデミア ～アルケミストは恋煩う～
source:
When Hiro Misaki steps into a convenience store to grab a late-night snack, he finds himself transported to another world.

“You have been chosen. As the hero who will save this world—”

Summoned as the familiar of Eros Strobel, Hiro enrolls at Animate Girls’ Academy, a school specializing in magic.

Eros Strobel: A noble-born witch who can’t use magic.
Melly: A laid-back, easygoing dragon mage with no sense of urgency.
Hibiki Flamel: A kemonomimi alchemist who’s always holed up in her lab.

With nothing but girls around him, Hiro’s new life in the magical world of Partition is filled with all sorts of… unavoidable situations.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ014725.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
当美咲宏走进一家便利店买夜宵时，他发现自己被带到了另一个世界。

“你被选中了。作为拯救这个世界的英雄——”

宏被埃洛斯·史特罗贝尔召唤，进入动画女子学院，这是一所专门研究魔法的学校。

爱洛斯·史特罗贝尔（Eros Strobel）：出身高贵的女巫，不能使用魔法。
梅莉：一个悠闲、随和的龙法师，没有紧迫感。
响·勒梅尔：总是躲在实验室里的兽类炼金术士。

周围只有女孩，小宏在分区魔法世界的新生活充满了各种……不可避免的情况。
